desc: Summon and fuse {c_number}5{/c} frenzied demons into a line for {c_number}8{/c} seconds. The demons block enemies and flail wildly, dealing {c_number}30%{/c} damage per hit to those in front of them.
relatedSkill.name: Wall of Agony

desc: 召唤并将 {c_number}5{/c} 只狂乱恶魔融合成一条阵线，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。恶魔阵线会阻挡敌人并疯狂挥击，对前方敌人每次攻击造成 {c_number}30%{/c} 点伤害。
relatedSkill.name: 苦痛之墙

desc: Summon a tortured demon on your enemies, dealing {c_number}60%{/c} damage and Taunting them to attack it for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.
relatedSkill.name: Tortured Wretch

desc: 在你的敌人身上召唤一个受折磨的恶魔，造成 {c_number}60%{/c} 点伤害，并嘲讽它们攻击恶魔，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。
relatedSkill.name: 折磨憎灵

desc: Create a shadowy totem for {c_number}8{/c} seconds that chains enemies, Tethering them to the area and preventing them from escaping.
relatedSkill.name: Dark Prison

desc: 生成一个持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒的暗影图腾，用锁链束缚敌人，将他们困在区域内并防止其逃脱。
relatedSkill.name: 暗黑监牢

desc: Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}Shadowform{/c} as well as {c_number}50%[x]{/c} increased Movement Speed which decays over {c_number}4.0{/c} seconds.
relatedSkill.name: Nether Step

desc: 穿行于地狱阴影间并在目标位置现身，获得 {c_number}4{/c} 层{c_important}暗影形态{/c}，同时获得 {c_number}50%[x]{/c} 移动速度加成，该效果在 {c_number}4.0{/c} 秒内逐渐衰减。
relatedSkill.name: 幽冥行走

desc: Summon a rampaging brute for {c_number}10{/c} seconds that smashes wildly, dealing {c_number}64%{/c} damage with a {c_number}5%{/c} chance per hit to {c_important}Eviscerate{/c} enemies for {c_number}1,280%{/c} damage.
relatedSkill.name: Rampage

desc: 召唤一只横冲直撞的蛮魔，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒。它会疯狂猛击，造成 {c_number}64%{/c} 点伤害，每次命中有 {c_number}5%{/c} 几率{c_important}剔骨{/c}敌人，造成 {c_number}1,280%{/c} 点伤害。
relatedSkill.name: 横冲直撞

desc: Summon a demonic head for {c_number}7{/c} seconds that breathes fire on enemies dealing {c_number}30%{/c} damage per hit.
relatedSkill.name: Infernal Breath

desc: 召唤一个持续 {c_number}7{/c} 秒的恶魔头颅，向敌人喷吐火焰，每次命中造成 {c_number}30%{/c} 点伤害。
relatedSkill.name: 冥狱魔息

desc: Summon a demon hand that Pulls enemies away from you, dealing {c_number}100%{/c} damage.
relatedSkill.name: Tyrant's Grasp

desc: 召唤一只恶魔之手，将敌人拉向远离你的位置，造成 {c_number}100%{/c} 点伤害。
relatedSkill.name: 暴君魔掌

desc: Summon a demonic eye for {c_number}15{/c} seconds that focuses upon enemies with a beam that makes them {c_important}Vulnerable{/c} and periodically blasts them, dealing {c_number}180%{/c} damage. Recast to direct the eye's targeting.
relatedSkill.name: Profane Sentinel

desc: 召唤一只持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒的恶魔之眼，以射线锁定敌人，使其陷入{c_important}易伤{/c}状态，并周期性轰击敌人，造成 {c_number}180%{/c} 点伤害。再次施放可重新指定恶魔之眼的目标。
relatedSkill.name: 渎神守望

desc: Create a subversive ritual for {c_number}10{/c} seconds that {c_important}Hexes{/c} enemies.

Killing {c_number}8{/c} enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to send forth shadow trails for {c_number}8.0{/c} seconds that periodically grant you {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}Shadowform{/c} while in them.
You can have up to {c_number}3{/c} trails active at once.
relatedSkill.name: Sigil of Subversion

desc: 创造一个持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒的亵渎仪式，对敌人施加{c_important}妖术{/c}。
在仪式中消灭 {c_number}8{/c} 名敌人或恶魔会为仪式充能，使其生成持续 {c_number}8.0{/c} 秒的暗影小径。当你身处小径中时，周期性获得 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}暗影形态{/c}。
最多可同时存在 {c_number}3{/c} 条暗影小径。
relatedSkill.name: 颠覆符印

desc: Create a binding ritual for {c_number}10{/c} seconds that extends the duration of your Summons.
Killing {c_number}8{/c} enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to summon a demon for {c_number}20{/c} seconds which attacks nearby enemies, dealing {c_number}80%{/c} damage per hit.
You can have up to {c_number}3{/c} demons active at once.
relatedSkill.name: Sigil of Summons

desc: 创造一个持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒的约束仪式，延长你召唤物的持续时间。
在仪式中消灭 {c_number}8{/c} 名敌人或恶魔会为仪式充能，使其召唤一个恶魔，持续 {c_number}20{/c} 秒，恶魔会攻击附近的敌人，每次命中造成 {c_number}80%{/c} 点伤害。
你最多可以同时激活 {c_number}3{/c} 个恶魔。
relatedSkill.name: 召唤符印

desc: Create a destructive ritual for {c_number}10{/c} seconds that grants you {c_important}Volatility{/c} while within.
Killing enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual's chaotic hellfire, increasing the chance for each enemy to explode for {c_number}50%{/c} damage on death.
relatedSkill.name: Sigil of Chaos

desc: 创造一个持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒的毁灭仪式，身处仪式范围内会使你获得{c_important}易爆{/c}状态。
在仪式中消灭敌人或恶魔会为混沌地狱之火注入能量，提高敌人死亡时发生爆炸并造成 {c_number}50%{/c} 点伤害的几率。
relatedSkill.name: 混沌符印

desc: Smash down {c_number}4{/c} demons into the ground, each dealing {c_number}55%{/c} damage.
relatedSkill.name: Bombardment

desc: 召唤 {c_number}4{/c} 只恶魔砸向地面，每只恶魔造成 {c_number}55%{/c} 点伤害。
relatedSkill.name: 恶鬼轰击
